justification: Both surfaces show a schematic quadruped in strict profile rendered as a flat, plain-infilled low-relief silhouette on the broad face of an upright rectangular pillar, and B's upper animal frieze includes a comparable striding beast. The decisive difference is density and content: A carries a single isolated animal with a small rectangular block on an otherwise blank field, whereas B is organised into stacked registers combining rows of repeated arch/H-shaped signs, a zigzag/net band, birds with spread wings, and several animals in vertical sequence.
